title: kate-core: dedent a Python return line
summary: python_newline drops one indent unit when the line is return, pass, break, continue, or raise. A colon line still gains one unit. The test goes in the existing indent tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: pub fn python_newline(buf: &TextBuffer, at: Offset, config: &DocumentConfig) -> String

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: indent.rs is a private module of workspace.rs. Its one test module is mod tests. Add the new function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. In python_newline, read the prefix with text_before_caret. When the line is not a comment and its first word is return, pass, break, continue, or raise, push a newline and the leading indent with one unit removed. The first word ends at the first ASCII whitespace. return: is not the word return. A comment line keeps its indent and does not drop a unit. Every other line keeps the current rule. Copy the leading indent. A colon that is not in a comment adds one indent unit. without_one_unit uses remove_unit and returns the indent after that prefix. An empty removal returns the same indent. Use the existing python_inserted helper. The test a_return_line_drops_one_indent_unit uses DocumentConfig::default. Four spaces and return returns a newline. Eight spaces and return returns a newline and four spaces. Four spaces, return, space, and x returns a newline. Four spaces and returning returns a newline and four spaces. Four spaces, hash, space, and return returns a newline and four spaces. def f(): still returns a newline and four spaces. def f(): pass still returns a newline. A tabs config with two tabs and pass returns a newline and one tab. break, continue, and raise with four spaces each return a newline. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: workspace::indent::tests::a_return_line_drops_one_indent_unit
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. python_newline on four spaces and return returns a newline and four spaces. After the change it returns a newline. Eight spaces and return returns a newline and four spaces. returning and a comment keep four spaces. def f(): still adds four spaces. def f(): pass still returns a newline. Two tabs and pass returns a newline and one tab.
